name: art-projects
prompt: The ants keep working on their art projects: the ant at the easel dabs paint on the canvas, the ant with the crayon scribbles back and forth, the cutting ant snips the red paper, antennae twitch. Static camera, nothing else moves.

name: ant-projects
prompt: The ant colony keeps building: the two ants carry the log across the top, the ant on the ladder climbs, the ant pushes the wheelbarrow, ants walk the little bridge, the draftsman ants lean over the blueprint. Static camera, gentle bustle everywhere.

name: pouring-ants
prompt: The boy tips the tray and the ants stream down into the ant farm, landing in the sand and scurrying into the tunnels. He watches, fascinated. Static camera.

name: kid-realizes
prompt: The boy leans in closer, eyes widening, mouth open; inside the box the tiny movie screen flickers and the ant audience shifts in their seats, a few ants walk along the top of the sand. Static camera.

name: theater-jars
prompt: The movie plays on the screen: the ant trapped in the jar presses against the glass and pounds on it. In the audience the ants munch popcorn and shift in their seats; in the tunnels below the ants tend their eggs and carry leaves. Static camera, the projector beam flickers.

name: theater-silhouette
prompt: The giant silhouette on the screen looms and reaches, pressing against the glass; the ants in the audience lean back, one nibbles popcorn, another sips from the cup, antennae quiver. Static camera, the screen flickers like a projected film.

name: theater-leaf
prompt: On the screen the ant nudges the leaf and the leaf sways; the ant audience watches, munching popcorn and sipping drinks, an usher ant walks the aisle, ants at the concession stand scoop popcorn. Static camera.

name: ant-farm-boy
prompt: The boy slowly moves the magnifying glass across the ant farm, his eye huge behind the lens; inside the box the ants crawl through the tunnels and along the top of the sand. Static camera.

name: ant-cities
prompt: The ants keep building their little cities: the crane swings its load, ants carry bricks up the ladder and across the bridge, the pulley ant hauls its bucket, ants walk between the buildings. Static camera, slow gentle activity in every chamber.

name: glass-marquee
prompt: The marquee bulbs chase around the sign; the line of ants shuffles forward toward the doors, the ticket ant hands over a ticket, the two ants in front turn to look up at the marquee. Static camera.

name: ants-in-theater
prompt: On the screen the ants inside the glass box crawl through their tunnels; the ant audience watches, the front ant eats popcorn one piece at a time, the other sips its drink, antennae sway. Static camera, projector flicker.

name: spoons-kitchen
prompt: Everyone in the kitchen concentrates on bending their spoon with their fingers; the spoons slowly curl, the man at the back raises his bent spoon in triumph, the others frown and keep trying. Static camera.

name: spoons-close
prompt: The five of them stare at their spoons, brows furrowed, fingers pressing; the spoons slowly bend and curl, the man in yellow blinks in surprise as his gives way. Static camera.

name: god-over-theater
prompt: The crowd streams out of the theater and walks toward the camera chatting; the giant face in the clouds watches them, eyes shifting, fingers curling over the cloud edge, the clouds drift slowly. Static camera.

name: kid-horrified
prompt: The boy stares in horror at the tiny movie theater inside his ant farm, mouth open, then slowly backs away; the tiny screen flickers and the ant audience shifts. Static camera.
